---
title: "Applied case studies"
---

The real-data casebank should favor datasets with clear licenses and health or biomedical interpretation.

| case | source | teaching use |
|---|---|---|
| `NMES1988` | `AER` | medical visits; Poisson vs NB vs zero-inflated/hurdle-style count models |
| `esoph` | R `datasets` | grouped binomial cancer case-control strata |
| `Contraception` | `mlmRev` | future bridge to correlated binary models; use marginal models only in current examples |
| `bioChemists` | `pscl` | publication count example with overdispersion/zero patterns |

Each case should show one intentionally imperfect model and one improved model, then compare QQ-normal and residual-versus-fitted patterns.
